stops.name: Natural Park Stromberg-Heuchelberg
stops.quote: With its 33,000 ha is Stromberg-Heuchelberg a small natural park, but for the many cities in the surrounding area the natural park is an important local recreation area.
stops.english: With its 33,000 ha, Stromberg-Heuchelberg is a small nature park, but for the many cities in the surrounding area, the nature park is an important local recreation area.
